ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (33) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Духовное начало» (dukhovnoe nachalo, 'spiritual principle') is 'principle', but the divine that «стремится к своему началу» (stremitsya k svoemu nachalu) strives 'toward its source'; «разумение» (razumenie) is 'understanding' and «заколдованный круг» (zakoldovannyy krug) 'vicious circle'. «Федор Страхов» is Fyodor Strakhov.
Source observation: [20] «самостоятелъную» is printed with ъ for ь (transcription slip); translated as 'independent'
